dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Lira! You're being moved to the pit.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: 'Just put in the time and you won't have to work the pit anymore.'

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: At this point I think Kip is lying to me.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: You'd think a year would be long enough to earn some respect around here.

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Watch your head.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: You act like I've never done this before.

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Enough with the attitude, keep it moving!

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: Am I really working alone again?

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Yes. Now, since I've gotten a bunch of complaints that you can't do your job, show me you still remember.

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Go pick up that heat unit over there.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Good, you still remember how to use your arms.

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: Now hold tthe heat unit in your hands and break it for warmth.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: You want to teach me how to walk again or can I get back to work?

dialogues.speaker: Shift Leader
dialogues.text: (agreeing grunt)

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: I'll get out of this mine someday.

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: Lira, what are those?

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: There was an explosion in the mine today so I dec...

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: Why did you bring those home!?

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: Because I'm sick of cold and saw an opportunity, so I took it.

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: Lira, do you know what the council would do to you if they found out you took them?

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: I'm just so tired of doing everything the way the council tells us to do it!

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: We provide light. We provide heat. You can rely on us.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: When has that ever been true?

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: You say that but they are the ONLY reason you're able to live your life.

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: Without them and the tower our planet would be a frozen wasteland, like outside the walls.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: Yeah, well if my mom were here, she'd be on my side.

dialogues.speaker: Kip
dialogues.text: Don't pretend you knew who she was.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: Well maybe I would know more about her if you didn't pretend she never existed!

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: My whole life, I've heard the same thing from everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: 'Your mother was wonderful.'

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: 'Your mother was so kind.'

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: 'Your mother was a genius.'

dialogues.speaker: Lira
dialogues.text: When am I going to get a real answer, and not one you'd give to a six-year-old?
